item.title: Global leaders, alumni to keynote LSMSA’s 42nd Commencement Ceremony
item.description: The Louisiana School for Math, Science, and the Arts (LSMSA) will celebrate its 42nd Commencement Ceremony on May 16, 2026, at 2 p.m. in Prather Coliseum at Northwestern State University. This year’s graduation features two distinguished members of one of the school’s earliest classes as keynote speakers: Boeing executive and retired Major General Lenny Richoux (’85) and international energy entrepreneur George H. Knost III (’85).
